title: China approves the market launch of an invasive BCI system that helps restore hand movement, the world's first approval of such a device for commercial use (Reuters)
summary: Reuters: China approves the market launch of an invasive BCI system that helps restore hand movement, the world's first approval of such a device for commercial use — China's drug regulator said on Friday that it has given the nod for a brain-computer interface (BCI) system that helps restore hand-movement ability …
